name: Malta
title: BENEFITS provider tool: Malta
wave_label: No microsimulation for this country: extra income estimated from national minimum-income outlays (EUROMOD external statistics and named national sources) and Eurostat income deciles

wellby_spine.label: EUR 14,141 (HM Treasury's GBP 13,000 per WELLBY at 2019 prices, applied as GBP 16,300 at 2024 prices, converted at household-consumption PPP)
wellby_spine.provenance_note: HM Treasury (2021) Wellbeing Guidance for Appraisal, GBP 13,000 per WELLBY at 2019 prices (low 10,000, high 16,000), applied as GBP 16,300 (12,540 / 20,064) at 2024 prices by HM Treasury's own uprating method, converted at EUR 0.8676 per GBP (Eurostat prc_ppp_ind, E011 household final consumption, 2024). A transfer, flagged as such.

capacity_caveat: The capacity and shock model is INDICATIVE: demand elasticities and staff ratios are mostly UK register values, and the share of households losing an earner is the UK model's own share applied to Malta's working-age households. It is not calibrated to Malta.
provenance: No microsimulation for Malta: the income effect is estimated from the national minimum-income outlay and Eurostat income deciles, and household counts, price levels and labour costs are Eurostat database tables (nama_10_gdp, prc_ppp_ind, lc_lci_lev, lfst_hhnhtych, demo_pjan, ilc_di01, ilc_lvps02), retrieved September 2026. Provider values are per person served, in EUR at 2024 prices. Every value carries its source and a grade in its own note; a value borrowed from another country is marked.

services.name: Employment support

provenance_note.elastLow: UK register value for Jobcentre Plus work coaches (demand moves one-for-one with unemployment, range 0.8 to 1.2), transferred unadjusted
provenance_note.elastCentral: UK register value for Jobcentre Plus work coaches (demand moves one-for-one with unemployment, range 0.8 to 1.2), transferred unadjusted
provenance_note.elastHigh: UK register value for Jobcentre Plus work coaches (demand moves one-for-one with unemployment, range 0.8 to 1.2), transferred unadjusted
provenance_note.staffRatio: UK register benchmark, shown for reference only: no formula in the tool reads it; the extra-caseworker figure uses the provider's own cases per caseworker.
provenance_note.unitCost: EUR 878, converted from the UK tool's unit cost for Jobcentre Plus work coaching, GBP 1,200 per participant, itself an assumption declared at the 2024 base. Converted on average hourly labour cost in health and social work (Eurostat lc_lci_lev, NACE Q, 2023: Malta EUR 22.10 an hour; UK GBP 30.2165), ratio 0.731388. No verified Malta figure for this unit was found. CONVERSION: GBP 1200 x 0.73138848. PRICE BASE: 2024-equivalent. Unit: one participant in an employment-support episode.

services.flag: Unit: one participant in an employment-support episode. Outcome value: borrowed from another country without adjustment. +0.46 WELLBY for a move from unemployment into work (Clark et al. 2018, the Britain fixed-effects coefficient HM Treasury's guidance uses), valued at the WELLBY value for Malta, then staged as in the UK tool: effect 0.11 / 0.30 / 0.46 x attribution 0.20 / 0.22 / 0.27. European trial evidence (Card, Kluve and Weber 2018) puts job-search assistance impacts at 1 to 2 percentage points, which suggests the staged central may be high. ORIGIN 16300 FACTOR 0.3990732862; BAND ORIGIN 12540 AND 20064; BAND FACTOR 0.3990732862 AND 0.3990732862; STAGE EFFECT 0.11 0.3 0.46 ATTRIBUTION 0.2 0.22 0.27; PRICE BASE: 2024-equivalent.

services.flag: Unit: one claim supported. Outcome value: borrowed from another country with a stated adjustment. Income effect: the extra-income figure. Health-service use avoided: Liverpool Citizens Advice on Prescription (SSM Population Health 2025), an instrumental-variable study on linked NHS records: GBP 91 per person a year (95% CI 44 to 107) at 2023 prices, an impact, so attribution 1.0. The saving is per household member; the central counts the client only, the high counts every member (20,773 members of 8,205 client households). Uprated to 2024-25 on ONS L8GG and converted at household-consumption PPP (Eurostat, 2024). The advice covered benefits, debt and housing together. Pain and suffering are shown as a sensitivity, not added, as settled decision 8 does for Spain. Drug & alcohol treatment.provenance_note: Value of a statistical life for Malta: EUR 5,613,202 (OECD 2025 base VSL for the EU, USD 8.4m at 2022 PPP, transferred by GDP per head in PPS with income elasticity 1.0, as the OECD recommends). Deaths averted per 1,000 opioid-client-years: central 21.45 (France, 175,000 patients, 2026), low 6.5 (Czechia), high 24.8 (Sordo et al. 2017, methadone). Share of clients who are opioid clients: 0.441 (UNODC (2025), World Drug Report 2025, Statistical Annex 5.1: Treatment by primary drug of use: 1019 / 2311 = 0.441). Non-opioid clients carry no averted-death value in these figures.
